units.source_text: 我的心灵并没有掀起一丝的波澜。

en.t: Not the slightest ripple was stirred in my heart.

units.source_text: 她的嘶哑声音、她的彬彬有利的举止和高雅的谈吐，尽管她顾忌我在场，

en.t: Her hoarse voice, her courteous manners, and her refined way of speaking, though she was mindful of my presence,

units.source_text: 但她冲着柏木吐露怨言时，眼睛里还是闪烁着粗野的神色……

en.t: still, when she poured out her complaints to Kashiwagi, a coarse look flickered in her eyes...

units.source_text: 这些至今我仍记忆犹新。

en.t: Even now, I remember these things vividly.

units.source_text: 这时我才明白柏木今晚把我唤来的原因，

en.t: Only then did I understand why Kashiwagi had called me there that night,

units.source_text: 原来是要利用我做挡风的墙。

en.t: he had meant to use me as a wall against the wind.
